resources.string: SMB login failed. Check the username, password and (if needed) domain configured for this sync task.
Access was denied. Check Android folder permissions and whether the SMB account may read or write to this shared folder.
The shared folder or file could not be found. Check the share name, folder path, and whether the source still exists.
The destination may be full. Check free space on the target storage or NAS.
A file is in use by another process. Close it on the server and retry.
The SMB connection was refused. Check that SMB file sharing is enabled on the server and port 445 is reachable.
The server could not be reached. Check Wi-Fi or VPN, the server address and DNS. Try the server IP address.
The connection timed out. Check whether the NAS is awake, the network is stable and SMB port 445 is accessible.
Client and server may disagree on SMB protocol or signing requirements. Check the configured SMB version and server settings.
The operation failed, but the exact cause cannot be identified from this message alone. Copy the technical details below to investigate further.
